responsibility: This autogenerated companion file maps AArch64 command-line options from `aarch64.opt` to the corresponding GCC manual anchors. It supplies `UrlSuffix` entries for target switches such as `-march`, `-mcpu`, `-mabi`, SVE, early RA, and load-pair fusion options, so GCC’s generated option help and diagnostics can attach documentation URLs for AArch64-specific options without duplicating that metadata in the option-definition file itself.
